stem: Sofia separated some figures into two sets. The figures in Set A have a common characteristic. The figures in Set B do not have the characteristic.
instruction: Which of these is the best description of the common characteristic of the figures in Set A?

options.label: G
options.text: They have at least one circular base.

options.label: H
options.text: They have at least one edge.

options.label: J
options.text: They have faces that are polygons.

visual_elements: Set A contains drawings of a cylinder and a sphere.
Set B contains drawings of a cone, a hexagon, and a cube.
difficulty_rationale: Requires understanding of geometric figure properties and reasoning about which characteristic is common to one set but not the other.
